description: GreenDelta's openLCA package ships two `Chromium III` rows to Emission to air/low population density that reach Chromium(3+) in rural air with different EF 3.1 numbers: 017c1ca1 states EF's chromium(3+) factors and d43572af EF's elemental chromium factors, so on the six-list build of 3b6528e GreenDelta's implementation published neither in the four categories they share. d43572af's name, CAS number and formula `Cr3+` are chromium(3+)'s, and every other method in the package scores it as chromium(3+), so its EF 3.1 numbers are read as a mis-mapping and a ruling in lcia-factor-collision-rulings.json publishes 017c1ca1's (#445, using #444).

expectations.title: GreenDelta's freshwater ecotoxicity factor for chromium(3+) in rural air is 333.75, its chromium(3+) row's
expectations.comment: The package's rows 017c1ca1 and d43572af state 333.75 against 4,292.06. On the build of 3b6528e GreenDelta's implementation published neither; the ruling publishes 017c1ca1's, which is also the JRC's and ecoinvent's number for this flow.
